title: Khloe Kardashian reveals which sister called her 'fat and so ugly' before weight loss - NewsBreak
text:
By Scarlett O'Toole ,
38 minutes ago Khloe Kardashian has revealed one of her sisters called her "fat and so ugly" before her 40lbs weight loss.
The 41-year-old has smashed her fitness journey in recent years, losing weight after focusing on nutrition and exercise. However, Khloe has admitted it wasn't all easy and spoke about how she was treated before her weight loss on the latest episode of The Kardashians .
In the episode, Khloe revealed her sister Kourtney Kardashian would tease her when she was "20lbs overweight." The pair met at Kourtney's house, where the 46-year-old Lemme founder spoke to her sister about therapy and how it helped her to realize how much she hated it when her family "would say something kind of snarky to me."

READ MORE: David Muir halts show for 'heartbreaking update' as he makes ABC World News Tonight return
Kourtney explained how she is "almost mad sometimes" after coming to some realizations in therapy. She shared, "You like, realize some of the things. Like, I remember I had a wall up from when I was young, from being like, protecting myself and when I went to therapy, then I had feelings and I would get things out and then I would be like, when Kim or you would say something kind of snarky to me that we've said to each other our whole lives, I would be like, 'Who says that to their family member? How unkind.'"
The mom-of-four admitted she would "feel bad" about things her sisters were saying to her. Khloe didn't seem too happy with Kourtney's comments as she simply replied, "Right."
Kourtney continued, "And then I had to get through that time of feeling really, really sensitive I think." Speaking in a confessional, she added, "I remember after I started therapy, feeling like, 'Why did I do this? I was so much happier before when I didn't know all these things.'
"It's like ignorance is bliss and then once you get to the other side and then you're like, 'Oh, this is why I did this.' And I hope that she gets to that place."
Khloe, however, wasn't impressed. In a confessional, she shared, "It's crazy when she says, 'Oh, you and Kim would say things that would hurt my feelings.'
"There are so many times that Kourt, like the fun Kourt, I didn’t take it personally, when she was like, 'Oh, you just look 20 pounds overweight, oh you’re fat, oh you’re so ugly, you’re this,' but not in like a mean way. It was just funny how we would talk to each other."
The Good American founder admitted her sister has "made a change," but added, "And I’m like, 'Well, actually we’re just doing what we’ve always done. You’ve just decided to remove yourself. We didn’t get that memo.' And now we’re being painted like we’re these terrible monsters when I’m like, 'No, we’re happy to stop. We just didn’t know you wanted us to stop.'"
The Kardashians Season 7 is available to stream on Disney+.
